question: Across the last two years of the repository's 54-symbol long-history OKX USDT perpetual universe, which completed 4h windows most resemble the Owner-supplied BTC 2026-08-19 MA-compression launch, including an exact price-axis SHORT mirror?
universe_rule: For each okx_*_USDT_SWAP_15m_*.csv in data/kline_deep, choose the longest declared-row snapshot; require exactly 54 unique symbols. Resample only complete 16x15m UTC buckets and merge one bounded public OKX 4H page after exact OHLC overlap parity.
single_variable: Direction orientation only: the same frozen LONG reference tensor is evaluated directly and after an exact price-axis SHORT mirror; universe, window, gates, feature scales, weights, distance, DTW, deduplication, top-N and null control stay identical.

ranking_contract.rerank_stage: Exact multivariate DTW with Sakoe-Chiba radius 2, computed separately on the 30-bar prelude and 12-bar release; 35% prelude plus 65% release.
ranking_contract.final_distance: 45% coarse plus 55% split-DTW; lower is more similar and is not a probability.
ranking_contract.exclusion_zone: Within one symbol and direction, anchors within 18 bars are one event neighborhood; keep the lowest final distance.
ranking_contract.selection: Return exactly eight non-overlapping LONG and eight non-overlapping SHORT candidates if available. The supplied BTC reference is shown separately and excluded from ranking and null-control top-N.

null_control.method: Keep the exact 30-bar reference prelude and the same multivariate set of 12 release rows, but randomly permute the release-row order 200 times. Compare each null query's deduplicated top-eight coarse mean distance with the real query.
null_control.null_hypothesis: The temporal ordering of the supplied release is no more retrievable than the same amplitudes and channel values in random release order.
null_control.p_value: One-sided lower-is-better randomization p with plus-one correction.

holdout.authorization_scope: Owner explicitly requested similar 4h long or short shapes from the most recent two years, anchored by the attached 2026-08-19 BTC screenshot.
holdout.post_result_rule: Do not tune gates, weights, windows, DTW radius, deduplication or top-N after seeing the scan. A changed configuration needs fresh Owner authorization and a new consumption number.
